'''Assimilated Sheep''', known internally as '''Infsheep''', are the [[Assimilated Mobs|Assimilated Version]] of Sheep.

== ''Spawning'' ==
* Spawned when a Sheep succumbs to [[Call Of The Hive|Call of The Hive]] below [[Evolution Phases#Phase 7|Phase 7]].
* Spawns naturally in groups of 3 to 5, from [[Evolution Phases#Phase 2|Phase 2]] through [[Evolution Phases#Phase 7|Phase 7]], with a spawnweight of 25, once 3 Sheep have been assimilated.
** Can spawn as White, Gray, and Black variants.<ref>60% chance to be White, 30% chance to be Gray, and 10% chance to be Black.</ref>
* Spawned by [[Stage II Beckon|Stage II]] and [[Stage III Beckon|Stage III Beckons]].
* Spawned by [[Adapted Summoner|Adapted Summoners]].
* Spawned by level 3 or higher [[Scent System|Scents]].

== ''Behavior'' ==
Assimilated Sheep are Melee Combatants.

* Their Melee Attack is performed through contact damage.
* Any Mob within 3 blocks of an Assimilated Sheep will be inflicted with COTH. This does not go through walls.
* Assimilated Sheep are able to traverse faster in liquids by performing small leaps.
* Assimilated Sheep are able to dive in liquids to pursue submerged targets.
* If an Assimilated Sheep gets 5 kills and is within range of a [[Moving Flesh]] or 3 other Assimilated Mobs<ref>Excluding [[Assimilated Ender Dragon]] and [[Assimilated Big Spider]].</ref>, it will evolve into a Moving Flesh.
* If an Assimilated Sheep gets 60 kills and is unable to turn into Moving Flesh, it will evolve into a [[Feral Sheep]].
* On death, Assimilated Sheep have a chance to explode, releasing [[Remains|Assimilated Remains]], 3 [[Buglin|Buglins]], and an effect cloud of stacking Poison and [[Call Of The Hive|COTH]].
** When not exploding, there is a 50% chance an Assimilated Sheep will drop its [[Walking Sheep Head|Head]].
=== ''Weaknesses'' ===

* Assimilated Sheep, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.

* Assimilated Sheep are known as '''Infsheep''' in the mod files.
* Like regular Sheep, Assimilated Sheep can be dyed White, Gray, and Black.
